paragraphs: “That Galilean expounded before Rav Chisda”: Shabbat 31b and 88a, Bava Kamma 52a, Sanhedrin 113a and Makkot 23a. “A passing Galilean expounded”: Sanhedrin 70a and Chullin 27b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: עליה דרב חסדא describes the Galilean expounding before Rav Chisda. The heading groups Galilean attestations rather than identifying them all as one person.

The checked passages in Shabbat 88a, Bava Kamma 52a and Makkot 23a use עליה דרב חסדא; Sanhedrin 113a explicitly says the Galilean expounded before Rav Chisda. Sanhedrin 70a and Chullin 27b have a passing Galilean. The intended Shabbat 31b attestation was not established in the bounded 31a–b check. The collection does not establish that all these Galileans were one person.
